kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Thanksgiving storm batters East Coast. And, Black Friday sales to hit record levels
wire.summary: A powerful storm knocked out power for nearly 1 million customers and flooded streets. And, experts predict inflation will not dampen American spending for the holidays

wire.title: French cinema star Gérard Depardieu ordered to stand trial for rape and sexual assault
wire.summary: The case has become one of the most prominent in France's reckoning with sexual violence, as the #MeToo movement has faced resistance in the country, particularly in the arts.

wire.title: From Thanksgiving blackouts to Black Friday, a holiday hit by wild weather and economic woes
wire.summary: A storm battered much of the country on Thursday, knocking out power to thousands of homes and disrupting travel. Today, Black Friday shopping deals kick off, and on Saturday New York City will hold the postponed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

wire.title: Can luxury save Macy's?
wire.summary: This week's celebration of Macy's 100th Thanksgiving parade finds the department store at a turning point. After years of losing sales, the retailer is reimagining itself — as a higher-end destination.

wire.title: Screen-free tweens try their hand at Dungeons & Dragons
wire.summary: Some parents, fed up with screens, have found an analog oasis in the role-playing game invented in the 1970s.

wire.title: Trump effectively ended asylum. Advocates look to the Supreme Court to restore it
wire.summary: Trump's sweeping immigration changes — an asylum ban, mass firings and new legal maneuvers — have all but ended asylum. The high court will soon consider whether some shifts deny people due process.

wire.title: 12 strategies to cut your risk of dementia. Take this quiz to start
wire.summary: Here's something you can do as you gather with family and friends this holiday season: Take a free, five-minute quiz to assess your brain health. You'll learn simple changes to keep your mind sharp.

wire.title: Morning news brief
wire.summary: Thanksgiving storm pummels the East Coast, Americans expected to spend record amount on Black Friday, Israeli rival factions consider deals in race to form a new government.

wire.title: New balloons will fly in the postponed 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
wire.summary: Some new balloons are set to fly in the weather-delayed Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

wire.title: Eagles rally to stun Cowboys coming back from 21 points behind
wire.summary: Eagles QB Joe Milton threw two long touchdowns against the quarterback's former team, the Dallas Cowboys, for the the start of quite a comeback, after being down 31-10 early in the third quarter.

wire.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
wire.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

wire.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
wire.summary: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

wire.title: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
wire.summary: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?

wire.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
wire.summary: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.

wire.title: Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'
wire.summary: France's president made the comment while speaking to French farming representatives, months after the EU banned Brazil beef and poultry products.

wire.title: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
wire.summary: There are fears of a major oil spillage off Ibiza but the ship's fuel tanks are so far intact.
